delve.already_active: You already have an active delve! Use the flee button to escape.
delve.auto_rescue_wait: ⏳ Your {pet} is working to free you. Check back in {minutes} minute(s).
delve.auto_rescued: 🆘 You've been rescued! Your loyal {pet} dragged you from the darkness! You're free to delve again.

combat.ambush_desc: A creature bursts from the shadows, catching you off guard!
combat.bone_wraith_pierce: The Bone Wraith's strike pierces your armor!
combat.entangled: You are entangled and your attack is weakened!
combat.flee_description: You flee the depths, escaping with your life. You lose {gold} gold.
combat.fortified: Your fortified weapon glows. Extra damage!
combat.guarded_absorb: Your guard absorbs part of the blow!
combat.marked_warning: You feel an unnatural mark upon you. Enemies hit harder.
combat.mend: You mend your wounds, restoring {heal} HP.
combat.molten_core_explode: The Molten Core explodes for {damage} damage!
combat.navigate_collapse: Part of the ceiling collapses! Dust and debris fill the air.
combat.navigate_trap_avoid: You trigger a floor trap but roll clear just in time!
combat.navigate_trap_hit: The floor gives way! You take {damage} damage.
combat.plague_bearer_poison: The Plague Bearer's wound festers. Poison seeps into your veins!
combat.power_blow: You unleash a devastating blow for {damage} damage!
combat.spore_host_poison: The Spore Host bursts, releasing a cloud of toxic spores! You are poisoned.

delve.cooldown_death: You cannot delve again today. Wait for rescue or until tomorrow.
delve.death_auto_rescue: Your loyal {pet} refuses to leave your side! They will drag you to safety soon. Check back with `/delve` in a few minutes.
delve.death_fell: The darkness claims you on floor {floor}. Your limbs grow cold, your vision fades. {auto_msg}
delve.death_no_rescue: Your pets couldn't reach you. Another adventurer on this floor may find you and pull you back.
delve.fallen_wait: 💀 You fell on floor {floor}. Your pets couldn't reach you. Another adventurer may find you there, or try again tomorrow.
delve.revived: 🆘 A new day dawns and you crawl free of the darkness. You can delve again.

handler.boss_gate_desc: A massive guardian bars the path to floor {floor}. The air trembles with its presence. You must defeat it to go deeper.
handler.boss_victory: The {name} falls! The path deeper opens before you.
handler.death_auto_rescue_msg: Pet refuses to leave your side! They will drag you to safety soon.
handler.death_fallen_desc: The Undercroft has claimed you this day. Your journey ends for now.
handler.death_no_rescue_msg: Your pets could not reach you. Another adventurer on this floor may find you.
handler.defend_room: You raise your guard and slip past the creature. The next strike against you will be weakened.
handler.doppelganger: The victim snarls and transforms! It was a doppelganger lying in wait!
handler.flee_combat_fail: You stumble! The {enemy} lands a free hit for {damage} damage!
handler.flee_combat_success: You slip away from combat, leaving {gold} gold behind.
handler.flee_fail: You stumble as you try to flee! The enemy blocks your escape and lunges at you!
handler.flee_success: You slip away before the enemy can react, retreating to the safety of the passage.
handler.forge_scavenge: You scavenge useful parts from the workshop. +{gold} gold!
handler.forge_scavenge_key: You also find a Dungeon Key!
handler.forge_temper: You stoke the forge and temper your weapon. It glows with renewed strength. +5 ATK for the next combat.
handler.garden_burn: The garden burns brightly! You warm yourself in the flames and recover {heal} HP.
handler.garden_harvest_heal: You harvest a glowing sporefruit. It heals you for {heal} HP!
handler.garden_harvest_poison: The spores invade your lungs as you harvest. You feel poison spreading through your veins.
handler.graveyard_spook: A spectral figure materializes before you, offering a dusty relic. You accept and feel a chill settle over your soul.
handler.level_up: Level up! Now Level {level} (+2 skill points, ⭐ +1 perk choice, 👑 +1 crown)
handler.locked_force_fail: The door mechanism triggers a trap! You take {damage} damage.
handler.locked_force_success: You throw your shoulder against the door. It bursts open!
handler.locked_key_success: The key turns smoothly. Beyond the door lies a hidden chamber!
handler.merchant_haggle_fail: Think you are clever? the merchant sneers. Prices just went up.
handler.merchant_haggle_success: Your silver tongue earns you a nod. The merchant mutters, Fine, one discount but don't push it.
handler.no_potions_bandage: You have no potions to use as bandages!
handler.no_torches_burn: You have no torches to burn the garden!
handler.no_torches_forge: You need a torch to reheat the forge!
handler.npc_intimidate_success: You loom over the captive and snatch their belongings. They cower and do not resist.
handler.rest_bandage: You use a potion to clean and dress your wounds. +15 HP.
handler.rift_disturb: Your presence disturbs the rift! A being of pure chaos coalesces and attacks!
handler.rift_gaze_fail: The void gazes back! Pain sears your mind for {damage} damage.
handler.rift_gaze_success: You gaze into the void and glimpse forbidden knowledge. You feel enlightened. Your next victory will grant more XP.
handler.shrine_defile: You tear down the shrine and take {gold} gold. A dark weight settles over you.
handler.shrine_donate: You donate {gold} gold to the shrine. A gentle glow surrounds you. The blessing is yours.
handler.shrine_pray_fail: Your prayer goes unanswered. A wave of holy backlash burns you for {damage} damage!
handler.shrine_pray_success: You kneel before the shrine and pray. A warm light fills you. You feel blessed.
handler.spore_cloud: A cloud of glowing spores billows from a crack in the wall. You breathe them in before you can hold your breath. Poison courses through your veins.
handler.steam_vent_hit: Scalding steam blasts you from a vent! You take {damage} damage.
handler.steam_vent_seal: A steam vent hisses ominously. You jam a torch into the mechanism, sealing it. +{xp} XP
handler.tomb_open_empty: The sarcophagus is empty. Dust and disappointment.
handler.tomb_open_guardian: The sarcophagus lid explodes outward! An ancient guardian rises, fury in its hollow eyes.
handler.tomb_open_success: The sarcophagus creaks open revealing a gleaming treasure!
handler.tomb_respect: You bow before the ancient dead. A faint warmth settles in your chest. A blessing from the honored fallen.
handler.whispers: The void whispers your name. It offers power, and you accept. A shiver of insight and a weight settles into your bones.
handler.rescue_wrong_floor: That player is not on your floor.
handler.rescue_dm:
🆘 **You've been rescued!**
{rescuer} found you in the depths of The Undercroft and pulled you to safety! You may now delve again.
handler.disarm_success: With steady hands, you disarm the trap. The treasure is yours!
handler.disarm_fail: You slip! A trap triggers for {damage} damage.
handler.mimic: The chest is a mimic! It bites you for {damage} damage before scuttling away.
handler.chest_open: You throw the chest open! Inside, a treasure awaits.
handler.chest_gold: The chest is packed with coins! +{gold} gold!
handler.leave_room: You step away from the opportunity.
handler.sacrifice_desc: You offer a piece of your vitality to the altar. Max HP reduced by {cost}.
handler.desecrate_desc:
You defile the altar and take its gold. (+{gold} gold)
A dark mark settles over your soul... Enemies will hit harder.
handler.merchant_welcome: "Take a look, take a look! Fine wares from the deep!"
handler.cache_open:
You crack open the Mystery Cache! Inside: {item}
{text}
handler.cache_empty: The cache is empty... Bad luck.
handler.rest_torch: You light a torch and rest. Recovered {hp} HP and {mana} Mana.
handler.sleep_restored: You sleep deeply and wake fully restored. HP and Mana at maximum!
handler.sleep_ambush: You are ambushed in your sleep! Take {damage} damage and scramble to your feet.
handler.npc_help:
You free the captive. They press a gift into your hands before disappearing into the shadows.
+{gold} gold
handler.npc_betray: You sell them out for {gold} gold. Their betrayed eyes follow you as you walk away.
handler.riddle_correct: Correct! The door swings open, revealing a hidden chamber.
handler.riddle_wrong: "Wrong," groans the statue. A dart hits you from the darkness. (-10 HP)
handler.artifact_leveled: 💠 **Artifact leveled up!** Use `/artifact` to assign your new stat point.
handler.gravewarden_desc: The air grows cold. A figure of bone and shadow rises before you, ancient armor creaking with each movement. The Gravewarden has been waiting.
handler.forge_magnet: You sweep the abandoned forge with the **{item}**. Scrap ore leaps to it: {loot}
handler.forge_magnet_none: You have no magnet to sweep the forge with. The scrap stays rusting in place.
handler.archive_read_success: You read a tome older than the village. The words sink into you like water into stone. +{xp} XP and a flicker of insight — your next victory will grant more XP.
handler.archive_read_fail: The tome's wards flare! Runes sear your mind for {damage} damage, and a cold weight settles over you.
handler.archive_search_loot: You dig through the shelves and pull free a sealed crate!
handler.archive_search_gold: You find a pouch of old coins wedged between the books. +{gold} gold!
handler.archive_search_trap: A pressure plate snaps! Hidden darts fly out, dealing {damage} damage.
handler.archive_search_empty: Dust and dead moths. The shelves give nothing but silence.
handler.fountain_blessing: The fountain ripples as your coin sinks. Warm water surges up and knits your wounds. +{heal} HP!
handler.fountain_potion: A bottle bobs to the surface — a potion, still sealed! ({p}/{m})
handler.fountain_loot: The water recedes, revealing something glinting at the bottom!
handler.fountain_empty: The coin sinks without a ripple. The fountain accepts your offering silently.
handler.fountain_drink_heal: The water is cold, clean, and impossibly sweet. You feel restored. +{heal} HP!
handler.fountain_drink_poison: The water turns bitter! Your stomach knots as poison spreads through you.
handler.ossuary_search_loot: You pry open a sealed bone casket. Something gleams within!
handler.ossuary_search_gold: You sift through the bones and find a hoard of old coins. +{gold} gold!
handler.ossuary_search_empty: Only dust and polished bone. The dead keep their secrets.
handler.ossuary_search_guardian: The bones stir! A guardian of dead stone and cracked ribs heaves itself upright, fury in its hollow eyes!
handler.ossuary_rest: You lay the dead to rest and speak a quiet word for them. The bones settle, and warmth fills you. +{xp} XP and a blessing.
handler.bridge_cross: You leap across the collapsing span and scramble to safety! +{xp} XP
handler.bridge_fall: The bridge gives way! You crash down with the rubble for {damage} damage.
handler.mist_clear: You hold your breath and walk through the mist. On the other side, insight settles over you. +{xp} XP and a flicker of enlightenment.
handler.mist_cursed: The mist coils around you and whispers your name. A cold weight settles into your bones.
handler.warden_quest_start: The Lost Warden looks up. Their voice is old and tired, like stone that remembers water. "You can see me." They ask you to descend and find what they lost, long ago.
handler.warden_quest_advance: The Warden nods, slow and solemn. They share a fragment of their story, and the weight between you shifts.
handler.warden_quest_progress: The Warden watches you, patient as a locked door. "Deeper," they say. "The depths hold what I lost."
handler.warden_blessing: The Warden bows. A faint light passes from them to you, and you feel strengthened. +{xp} XP
handler.warden_listen: The Warden speaks in fragments: of a vault, a promise, and a vigil that outlived its purpose. +{xp} XP

delve.ignore_fallen: You turn away from the cries in the darkness and press on.
delve.left_voluntarily: You ascend from the depths, your adventure complete. The Undercroft will remember your descent.
delve.no_session: No active delve. Start one with `{prefix}delve`!
delve.rescue_already_gone: That player is no longer fallen.
delve.rescue_cost_hp: 🤝 You rescued {user} from the darkness! -10 HP
delve.rescue_no_torches_hp: You're too weak to rescue anyone!
delve.rescue_overlay: A faint voice calls from the shadows... someone needs help!
delve.rescued_by_player: A hand grips yours in the darkness. {rescuer} pulled you from the depths back to the light! You may now delve again.
delve.start_desc: You descend into the darkness. The air grows cold. Somewhere ahead, something stirs.
delve.too_frail: You are too frail to make such a sacrifice.

desc.crypt_0: Water drips from cracked stone faces lining the walls. At the far end, a rusted iron gate blocks the passage.
desc.crypt_1: Fragments of bone crunch beneath your feet. Faint torchlight flickers across faded murals of forgotten kings.
desc.crypt_2: The air is thick with the smell of damp earth and old death. Shadowy alcoves line both sides of the hall.
desc.crypt_3: A cold draft whispers through the cracks in the masonry. Somewhere, water drips in a steady rhythm.
desc.crypt_4: Sconces flicker with green-tinged flames, casting dancing shadows on the vaulted ceiling.
desc.fungal_wilds_0: Giant mushrooms tower overhead, releasing clouds of glowing spores. The ground squishes with every step.
desc.fungal_wilds_1: Strange fungi pulse with bioluminescent light, illuminating a maze of twisting root-tunnels.
desc.fungal_wilds_2: The air is heavy with the sweet-sick smell of decay. Phosphorescent moss clings to every surface.
desc.fungal_wilds_3: Massive fungal growths have burst through the stonework, their tendrils pulsing with an inner light.
desc.fungal_wilds_4: Tiny glowing insects swarm around clusters of shelf fungi, casting the cavern in shifting patterns of light.
desc.forge_district_0: The heat hits you like a wall. Ancient forges still burn with unnatural flame, their bellows creaking on their own.
desc.forge_district_1: Molten metal flows through channels in the floor, casting an orange glow across walls of blackened stone.
desc.forge_district_2: The clang of hammer on metal echoes from somewhere deep within. Workbenches hold half-finished weapons, still warm.
desc.forge_district_3: Massive gears line the walls, some still turning slowly. The floor trembles with the pulse of hidden machinery.
desc.forge_district_4: Rusted chains hang from the ceiling, and the air shimmers with heat. A conveyor belt of cooled slag leads deeper.
desc.forge_district_5: A seam of shimmering light runs down the far wall, humming softly. You press a hand to it — the stone feels thin, like something breathes behind a curtain.
desc.forge_district_6: Dust lies in strange patterns across the floor: a key shape, a doorway, a line of marks repeated by something patient. A whisper follows you that sounds almost like a name.
desc.abyss_0: Reality bends here. The walls shift between stone, flesh, and void. You feel watched by something immense.
desc.abyss_1: Gravity fluctuates as you step forward. The path splits and reforms in ways that defy logic.
desc.abyss_2: Whispers echo from everywhere and nowhere. Fragments of forgotten memories cling to the air like cobwebs.
desc.abyss_3: The floor is a mirror of dark glass. Beneath it, shapes move — vast, slow, indifferent.
desc.abyss_4: Time loses meaning. You step and find yourself somewhere else, as though the room itself forgot you were there.
desc.monster_0: Something stirs in the darkness ahead, dragging claws across stone. It knows you're here.
desc.monster_1: A low growl rumbles from the shadows. Two pale eyes open, fixing on you with hungry intent.
desc.monster_2: The creature before you is a twisted mockery of life, its form barely held together by malice.
desc.monster_3: Chittering echoes from the ceiling as a mass of limbs and eyes descends toward you.
desc.treasure_0: A ornate chest sits in the center of the room, covered in dust but untouched by rust.
desc.treasure_1: Sunlight — impossibly — streams from above, illuminating a pedestal with a glowing object.
desc.treasure_2: Coin and gems spill from a cracked urn. Among them, something with a faint magical aura catches your eye.
desc.altar_0: A black stone altar dominates the room, its surface stained with something dark. In the center rests an item of power.
desc.altar_1: Carved from a single piece of obsidian, the altar pulses with a faint heartbeat. An offering awaits.
desc.merchant_0: A hunched figure in a tattered cloak tends a stall of curiosities. His smile reveals too many teeth.
desc.merchant_1: "Welcome, welcome!" chirps a floating mechanical sphere, its eye glowing blue. "Care to see my wares?"
desc.puzzle_0: A massive stone door blocks the way forward, covered in engraved symbols. An inscription at eye level poses a question.
desc.puzzle_1: The path is sealed by a wall of interlocking crystal gears. A riddle is carved into the frame.
desc.rest_0: A small alcove offers shelter. The remains of a campfire suggest someone else found safety here before.
desc.rest_1: A natural spring bubbles up through the floor, steam rising from its warm waters. The air is calm.
desc.npc_0: A figure huddles in chains against the wall, their eyes lighting up when they see you.
desc.npc_1: A wounded adventurer leans against the wall, clutching a bloodied side. "Please," they whisper, "help me."
desc.tomb_0: A stone sarcophagus dominates the chamber, its lid carved with the visage of a long-forgotten king. Dust motes dance in your torchlight.
desc.tomb_1: Rows of burial niches line the walls, some sealed with crumbling wax, others pried open by earlier thieves. One remains intact.
desc.tomb_2: A massive marble casket sits atop a raised dais. Faint runes glow along its edges, warning of danger — or promising reward.
desc.garden_0: Bioluminescent mushrooms carpet the floor, their caps pulsing with soft light. Strange fruits hang from fibrous stalks.
desc.garden_1: A patch of glowing flora thrives in the center of the cavern. Some look nourishing; others drip with ominous spores.
desc.garden_2: Delicate fungal blooms sway in an unseen breeze. The air is thick with a sweet, heady aroma that makes your head spin.
desc.anvil_0: An ancient anvil sits cold and silent. Tools lie scattered around it, still in remarkable condition. A forge pit yawns nearby.
desc.anvil_1: The heat of long-extinguished fires lingers. A workbench holds half-finished weapon parts, and a heavy hammer rests on the anvil.
desc.anvil_2: Gears and chains hang from the ceiling above a sturdy anvil. A metal press stands in the corner, its handle worn smooth by use.
desc.rift_0: The air distorts and shimmers. A vertical tear in reality hangs before you, pulsing with colors that shouldn't exist.
desc.rift_1: Gravity warps around a crack in the fabric of space. You feel pulled toward it — and see glimpses of other worlds within.
desc.rift_2: A wound in the world, bleeding light and shadow. The void whispers through it, offering secrets that burn to know.
desc.shrine_0: A small altar of white stone stands in a quiet alcove. Fresh flowers — impossibly — lie upon it, as if placed yesterday.
desc.shrine_1: Carved from a single piece of marble, a shrine to an unknown deity glows with a faint inner light. Someone still tends this place.
desc.shrine_2: Faded icons and burnt-down candles surround a humble shrine. The air here is warm and still, untouched by the dungeon's chill.
desc.locked_0: A heavy iron door blocks the passage, its lock intricate and well-maintained. Beyond it, you sense open space and treasure.
desc.locked_1: Rusted bars seal a promising corridor. The lock mechanism looks complex but functional — a key would turn it smoothly.
desc.locked_2: A reinforced door bars your way. Through a crack, you glimpse a glittering chamber beyond. The lock gleams, awaiting a key.
desc.archive_0: The passage widens into a sunken library. Shelves of water-warped tomes stand in patient rows, their bindings still intact. Dust hangs in the torchlight like a held breath.
desc.archive_1: Petrified bookshelves ring the chamber, their volumes sealed in hardened resin. One pedestal holds a single open book, its pages frozen mid-turn.
desc.archive_2: Scrolls lie scattered across a collapsed lectern, some still glowing faintly. A deep bookshelf hums with the weight of forgotten knowledge.
desc.fountain_0: A stone fountain burbles at the room's heart, its water impossibly clear. Coins from countless desperate hands glitter beneath the surface.
desc.fountain_1: Cracked marble basins catch a thin stream of glowing water. The liquid rises as you approach, as though curious.
desc.fountain_2: A basin of shimmering water stands in a ring of old offering bowls. The surface holds no reflection — only depth.
desc.ossuary_0: The room is stacked floor to ceiling with bones — femurs like ship timbers, skulls tucked between them like cargo. A single clear aisle leads to a heap at the center.
desc.ossuary_1: Thousands of knucklebones crunch underfoot. Piles of rib cages lean against the walls, and something at the center has been arranged with care.
desc.ossuary_2: An ossuary of the Ancients. Every niche is a careful stack, every stack a memory kept by someone who no longer remembers. A bone altar stands in the center.
desc.warden_0: A figure in rusted armor sits against the wall, a helm cradled in their lap. They do not move as you approach — but the air around them hums with a low, patient note.
desc.warden_1: Blue motes of light drift around a kneeling knight. Their armor bears no sigil, and their sword is planted point-down in the stone before them.
desc.warden_2: A pale guardian watches the passage from the shadows. Their eyes — if they have eyes — rest on you without fear. They have been waiting a long time.
desc.crypt_monster: Bones rattle in the corners as a shambling figure rises to block your path.
desc.passage_default: The passage stretches ahead into darkness.
desc.vault_key:
A sealed chamber older than the village. In the center, a black steel pedestal holds a single object: a **Vault Key**, inlaid with blue light, humming softly.

The air is still. Nothing stirs. The Ancients kept this room free of guardians — whatever else roams the Undercroft, it is not here.

**Take the key and leave. The depths are not for you yet.**

delve.vault_key_taken:
You take the **Vault Key** — black steel inlaid with blue light, humming against your palm.

"Gate lock: key present." The machine-voice of the Vault is almost satisfied.

Thorek's voice crackles over your comms: **"Good work. Now get out of there — the deeper floors will tear you apart at this level. Leave, grow stronger, and come back when you're ready."**

loot.veil_key_desc: A shimmering key that tears the fabric of reality. Required to enter the Veil Rift.
loot.dungeon_key_desc: A rusted iron key. It might open something in the depths.
loot.soulbound_line: 💜 **Soulbound** — will be recorded in your chronicle.

suffix_desc.the_vengeful_warden: Forged in the tears of a betrayed guardian.
suffix_desc.the_sunken_court: Retrieved from the depths of a drowned kingdom.
suffix_desc.the_forgotten_king: A relic of a ruler erased from history.
suffix_desc.the_ashen_remnant: Still warm from the fire that consumed its home.
suffix_desc.the_endless_depths: Seems to drink the light around it.
suffix_desc.the_shattered_oath: Remembers a promise that was broken.
suffix_desc.the_first_flame: The very first ember of creation.
suffix_desc.the_abyss_gazer: Looking into it, it looks back.
suffix_desc.the_crimson_tide: Still damp with the memory of battle.

echo.question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. No body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?

footsteps.question: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?

map.question: I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish. What am I?

river.question: Runs but never walks, has a mouth but never talks, a head but never weeps, a bed but never sleeps.

fire.question: I am not alive, but I grow; I don't have lungs, but I need air. What am I?

piano.question: What has keys but can't open locks?

joke.question: I can be cracked, made, told, and played. What am I?

ton.question: Forward I am heavy, backward I am not. What am I?

shirt.question: I have a neck but no head, two arms but no hands. What am I?

cold.question: What can you catch but not throw?

clock.question: I have a face but no eyes, hands but no arms. What am I?

chronicle.title: 📖 Personal Chronicle
chronicle.empty: No chronicle entries yet. Begin your journey with `/delve`!
chronicle.no_events: *No notable events recorded yet. Venture deeper.*
chronicle.footer: Your legend grows with every descent.

flags.first_descent: Your first descent into the Undercroft marked the beginning of a legend.
flags.escaped_alive: You emerged from the darkness, battered but breathing. The Undercroft would remember you.
flags.fell_in_battle: The depths claimed you once, but death is not the end for those marked by fate.
flags.fled_from_depths: You ran. The shadows whispered your cowardice, but survival has its own wisdom.
flags.cleared_floor_5: You were among the first to reach Floor 5. The Undercroft acknowledged your strength.
flags.cleared_floor_10: Floor 10. The Abyss opened before you, and you did not flinch.
flags.freed_prisoner: In the darkness, you chose mercy. A life freed because you decided it mattered.
flags.betrayed_npc: Gold over compassion. The chains you left behind still echo with broken promises.
flags.desecrated_altar: You defiled the sacred and took its power. The dark mark on your soul cannot be washed away.
flags.sacrificed_hp: A piece of your vitality, traded for strength. The altar drank deeply.
flags.solved_riddle: Your wit proved sharper than any blade. The vault opened its secrets to you.
flags.opened_treasure_trap: The chest's curse tested your resolve. You bore its mark and claimed its prize.
flags.disarmed_treasure: Steady hands and sharp eyes. The trap was disarmed, the treasure taken safely.
flags.spared_mimic: You sensed the deception and chose to spare the mimic. A strange friendship may yet bloom.
flags.merchant_purchase: The wandering merchant smiled as you traded. Somewhere, a deal is a bond.
flags.used_torch: A torch spent to restore your strength. Light is precious in the darkness.
flags.slept_unprotected: You slept without guard. The Undercroft could have taken you, but it let you wake.
flags.ambushed_while_sleeping: Your rest was shattered by claws in the dark. You survived, but trust is a luxury now.
flags.helped_warden: The Lost Warden bowed their head. 'One day,' they said, 'I will repay this debt.'
flags.set_item_collected: A piece of the ancient set now calls you its bearer. The power grows.
flags.full_set_equipped: You bear the complete set. Its legacy awakens, and the ground trembles.
flags.soulbound_keepsake: A soulbound keepsake found in the depths. It remembers what you did when no one was watching.
flags.mercy_on_enemy: The monster knelt, and you stayed your hand. Some debts cannot be quantified.
flags.defeated_zone_boss: The zone's master recognized your strength. Its defeat reshapes the dungeon's memory of you.
flags.rescued_another: You reached into the darkness and pulled another back. No one is forgotten.
flags.touched_by_shadow: The shadows recognize you. Where light falters, you have walked — and the darkness remembers.
flags.mask_of_malveillance: You claimed the Mask of Malveillance from the Gravewarden's grasp. The underworld stirs.
flags.tomb_raider: You dared to open the sealed sarcophagus and claim what lay within. The dead do not rest easy.
flags.shrine_blessed: A holy shrine recognized your worth. The blessing lingers like a warm ember in your chest.
flags.shrine_defiled: You defiled a sacred place and took its power. The light dims wherever you walk now.
flags.key_master: You unlocked the path with a key. The clever always find a way.
flags.scholar_of_depths: You read a tome older than the village and understood it. The depths taught you something in return.
flags.fountain_coin: You cast a coin into the dark waters. Whether the fountain listened, only the depths know.
flags.respected_the_dead: You laid the nameless dead to rest. Somewhere beneath the Undercroft, bones settle easier.
flags.warden_blessed: The Lost Warden bowed their head in thanks. Their light burns a little brighter for your help.

gauntlet.title: 🏆 Weekly Gauntlet
gauntlet.empty: No scores yet this week. Use `!gauntlet start` to begin your run!
gauntlet.footer: Everyone gets the same seed — pure skill!
gauntlet.started: ⚔️ **Weekly Gauntlet started!** Use `!delve` commands to navigate. Your seed is fixed for the week.
gauntlet.active: You already have an active run!
